evidence.summary: Round 2 closes the GOV-008 C1/K2 fail-open: a Session after_begin listener on the base ORM Session binds the request scope (transaction-local set_config) on every ORM transaction, sync and async. Live read-only on cip: sync SessionLocal under a non-admin empty scope now sees 0 products / 0 forecasts (was 18177 / 38625); AZ read-only sees 1, 0 other lines, 0 editable; admin sees 18177 before and after a commit. API restarted, healthy, unauthenticated /auth/me 401 local, web proxy and public. No new trust input: the listener reads only the contextvars the router sets from app_user.role and grant rows.

rationale: Every request-context ORM transaction, including threadpool and to_thread hand-offs, now carries the D-0056 scope; read-only lines are not writable on the sync paths. Residual: user-triggered background jobs (task queue, in-process fallback thread) run unscoped as workers; recorded as an open item for decision.
